assessmentRaw.opportunity: A standalone software-as-a-service (SaaS) tool for small to mid-sized independent equine boarding and training stables that automates precise, accessible, and unalterable documentation of each horse's care. This addresses the need to manage liability risks, avoid disputes with owners, and improve operational efficiency, as manual systems are prone to errors.
assessmentRaw.whoPays: The owner or barn manager of an independent equine boarding stable pays to mitigate liability risks, prevent owner disputes, and enhance operational efficiency through reliable record-keeping. (inference)
